name: AlphixLVRFee
mechanic: Admin-tuned per-pool LP fee plus a protocol fee skimmed to a treasury.
plain: Combines a per-pool LP fee that a restricted admin can adjust with a protocol fee captured from each swap's output as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to a treasury.
rules: A restricted admin sets the per-pool LP fee.
A protocol fee is skimmed from swap output to a treasury.
